END-TO-END ENTERPRISE AGENT MEMORY & LIVE KNOWLEDGE GROUNDING PIPELINE (L1 ➔ L4)
1. Verbatim Episodic Recall (mempalace ★60.6k): Store & retrieve exact user sessions and decisions locally with 96.6% R@5 and zero LLM API cost.
2. Structured ECL Ontology Memory (cognee ★33.5k): Extract entities & relationships from enterprise docs into a unified Graph + Vector store.
3. Version-Pinned SDK Docs (context7 ★65.3k): Ground coding agents in exact Next.js/Azure SDK/FastAPI version docs before generating code.
4. Zero-Key Web Crawl & Research (wigolo ★5.5k): Fetch live RFCs, changelogs & vendor pages locally over MCP without metered SERP API bills.
CLOSED-FORM FINOPS TCO MODEL (45-ENGINEER ENTERPRISE AGENT MEMORY & GROUNDING TEAM · SYNTHETIC WORKLOAD MODEL)
• Path A (Commercial Cloud Memory SaaS + Metered Web Search/Crawl APIs + Deprecated SDK Rework): $4,730.00/mo + 45.5h ($4,550.00) = $9,280.00/mo
• Path B (Azure AI Search + Cosmos DB Graph + Managed Bing Grounding): $1,890.00/mo PaaS + 10.5h ($1,050.00) = $2,940.00/mo
• Path C (mempalace + cognee + context7 + wigolo): $70.00/mo Compute + 2.4h ($240.00) = $310.00/mo (Saves $8,970.00/mo · -96.66%)
